description: Work management platform providing customizable collaboration tools, workspaces, and business workflow automation.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 authentication code flow for public apps and API keys / client IDs generated from account settings.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a Podio account and generate API keys freely from their account settings page.
api_notes: Complete programmable REST interface covering all Podio frontend functionality, data structures, apps, tasks, and webhooks.
rationale: Podio provides a fully documented REST API and self-serve API keys via a standard account sign-up.

evidence.note: Describes how to get an API key and authenticate applications.
Explains that developers can sign up with Podio and generate API keys from settings.
Outlines the comprehensive Podio API covering all frontend functionality and webhooks.
